info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Electronic Engineering

description.describe_ch: 根據學生從事之專題研究所進行的小型討論會，本課程主要提供學生進行口頭報告的實務訓練。討論會每次由幾位指定的學生進行口頭報告，由聽眾提問，並進行答辯以及綜合討論。學期中並穿插幾場外來學者演講，供學生觀摩學習。本課程可使學生經由事前對研究題材的整理，培養學生利用適當之媒體進行有效率的簡報能力；藉由報告過程的答辯與討論活動，提供學生改進口頭報告技能之機會；透過觀摩演講的過程，增進學生見識之深度與廣度。
description.describe_eh: Seminar is a group discussion for the students on their researches and studies. This course primarily provides oportunities for students to practice skills of oral presentation. During the course, some students were assigned to give talks about their researches or studies, the audience may ask questions and have discussions. A few invited talks are also given by some scholars in the semester. This course provides trainings for the students on preparation of the material before speaking, utilizing appropriate multimedia to give an effective presentation in the speaking. With the process of questioning and rebottling, it is possible for the students to improve their skills in briefing. The depth and spanning of the students' knowledge can also be expanded from the examples of the invited talks
